securityHold.title: Plaintext credential file in the synced vault
securityHold.statement: A file containing credentials in plaintext is present in a vault that syncs. Every device holding that sync holds the credentials, and every historical version of the sync holds them too. Rotation is required before removal, because deleting the file does not invalidate what it contained.
remediation: Rotate every credential the file contains, at the issuing service.
Remove the file from the vault and from the sync provider's version history.
Confirm no other copy exists in a backup, an export, or a second device.
Move the credentials to a purpose-built store outside this repository. This console does not hold credentials and must never be given that job.

canonicalSource.determination: The in-thread build of 24 April is the canonical source. Later copies are not.

steps.title: Export to a private repository and take a hash baseline
steps.why: An in-thread build has no history and no integrity check. Until it is exported and hashed there is nothing to deploy from and no way to tell later whether what was deployed is what was determined canonical.

steps.title: Deploy
steps.why: Deployment asserts an external event. It is unreachable until the export carries proof, because deploying an unhashed in-thread build is how a canonical source is quietly replaced by a copy of itself.

defects.title: File-ID collision
defects.detail: One file identifier is recorded against two different documents. One of the two rows is wrong. Until it is resolved, any reference resolved through that identifier may fetch the wrong document, and a citation to it proves nothing.
defects.resolution: Open the identifier, determine which document it actually is, and correct the other row. Do not delete either row — correct one and record the supersession.

defects.title: Seal assets — confirm before use
defects.detail: Seal assets exist in the document vault. Confirm the approved asset before any use. A seal is never recreated, redrawn, or regenerated — a recreated seal is a different seal, and every instrument carrying it is defective on that ground.
defects.resolution: Identify the approved seal asset and its file reference, and record it. Until then no instrument is sealed from this console.
